structured_output.hypothesis: If all domestic pigeon breeds descend from Columba livia and its geographic sub-species, then whole-genome variation in every sampled breed will nest within C. livia diversity, with no breed forming a clade outside C. livia or sister to it as a separate aboriginal species.
structured_output.pass_criterion: Align the SRA054391 reads to the C. livia reference and call genome-wide SNPs. Build a neighbor-joining or ML tree. Pass requires both: (a) all domestic breeds fall inside the C. livia clade, with no breed or group of breeds forming a clade with bootstrap >= 90% that is sister to or outside the feral and other domestic birds; (b) the median autosomal pairwise divergence between each breed and its nearest feral C. livia sample is <= 2x the median feral-to-feral divergence.
structured_output.fail_criterion: Claim refuted if any domestic breed, or group of breeds, forms a clade with >= 90% bootstrap support outside C. livia (for example sister to all other samples). It is also refuted if the median genome-wide divergence of any breed from all C. livia samples exceeds 3x the median feral-to-feral divergence. Either result is consistent with a separate wild stock.
structured_output.interpretation: Darwin's "aboriginal wild stocks" are read as separate wild species whose lineages split before the C. livia radiation. "Geographical sub-species" is read as within-species C. livia lineages, here feral birds. "Descended from" is read as monophyly of all breeds within C. livia in a genome-wide tree. This is a modern reinterpretation: the test uses genome-wide SNPs, not breed morphology. Limits: the data include few wild C. livia samples (mainly 2 feral birds), so introgression from other Columba cannot be fully excluded. The test covers only the sampled breeds (about 36), not every breed Darwin considered.

dataset.name: SRA study SRA054391: Whole Genome Sequencing of rock pigeon (Columba livia), raw reads for resequenced genomes of Shapiro et al. 2013
dataset.publisher: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (submitted by the Shapiro et al. group)
dataset.why_it_fits: Shapiro et al. 2013 (Science) cite SRA054391 as the raw reads for their resequenced genomes. The NCBI page lists 43 Illumina HiSeq 2000 whole-genome runs titled 'Whole Genome Sequencing of rock pigeon'. Per the paper, these cover 36 domestic breeds and 2 feral pigeons. I did not verify the breed count on the SRA page itself. Fields used: run accession, sample and breed attributes, and the reads. Reads are aligned to the C. livia reference assembly (BioProject PRJNA167554), which serves only as a mapping target. The reads allow tree-based and divergence tests of breed nesting within C. livia.
